_doc: Render massing for the former Spinnerij De Stoop (Spinnerijkaai 43-45, lofts and offices in a textile mill built by Camiel De Stoop), read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. GRB 1734211 (3560 m2, 3D GRB 14.25 m) rendered as a plain block, so the painter lost the tower (Tom's feedback 2026-11-14: 'redo the lofts'). Metres in Lambert 72 around 'anchor', u along 'axis_deg' -110.9 (u points SSW to the canal, u +27 is the canal front), v east (v -6 is the west side). DHMV II: the mill at 14 m; a square tower at the south-west corner on the canal, u 26..32, v -8..-2, ~20 m above the ground plus a belvedere. Look (Google Street View from the Groeningekaai, look-up only): red-brown brick mill of four storeys with tall windows, a flat dark roof, a square brick tower with an open belvedere at the west end of the canal front, a crenellated brick parapet at the east end.

parts.id: crenellated east end on the canal
